narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the codebase.
finalText:
**Big: 1291 hits across 94 files.** Most are safe. Three zones are not.

| zone | hits | call |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS vars | 979 | rename |
| repo SQL strings | 225 | needs a column migration first |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | never |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | never |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` plus wire key | 6 | never |

All 12 migrations ran in prod. The vendored SDK is regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`. `account_id` is a frozen public API field. See [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8).

Next: do not sign off on a blanket rename.
